name: Netshoot
description: Docker + Kubernetes network troubleshooting swiss-army container bundling 30+ networking tools including tcpdump, iperf3, nmap, scapy, and more.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker Hub image: nicolaka/netshoot; Docker Compose supported with example configuration; Kubernetes support via kubectl

eval_notes: All-in-one networking toolbox with 10k+ stars. Includes iperf3, nmap, scapy, tcpdump, fortio, and more in a single container. Perfect as a sidecar in evaluation environments for traffic generation, capture, and analysis.
